Coating Production Worker  New  What for you?  Apply immediately €16.70 gross per hour | Heerhugowaard | 2-shift system Do you enjoy hands-on work and do you like varied tasks? Do you want to work with your hands and see what you have made at the end of the day? Then this position as a coating production worker is for you! What are you going to do? As a Coating Production Worker, you contribute to protecting and finishing metal parts. You ensure that the materials are processed neatly and are ready for the next step in the production process. Your duties include, among other things: - Sanding galvanized metal parts with a special sanding machine. - Hanging metal parts on hooks so that they can be treated. - Collecting coated parts and checking whether they meet the quality requirements. - Checking for damage and neatly packaging the finished products. - Supporting the coating process, in which the metal parts receive a protective layer against corrosion. For larger and heavier parts, you use a forklift. You work in various locations within the department. That makes your work nice and varied! What are you bringing? You don't have to be able to do everything already. What we find most important is that you are motivated and eager to learn new things. In addition: - Can you communicate well in Dutch or English?. - Do you have technical insight, or would you like to develop it?. - Experience in production, metalworking, or powder coating is a plus. - Do you preferably have a forklift certificate or experience with an overhead crane or hoisting equipment?.
